summary: Lightning struck hikers on Mount Bierstadt about 11:30 a.m.; as many as 16 people affected; eight adults received emergency medical treatment at the trailhead, three taken to Denver-area hospitals (one serious); one dog killed
responding_agency: Search and rescue teams; Army National Guard high-elevation helicopter
notes: More than 100 people were on the mountain at the time; strike occurred about 500 feet below the summit. Five of the eight treated at the trailhead refused further treatment.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: peak (Mount Bierstadt)
